wsound_rocketblast89 v1.4.0 previews

All WAV files are generated by the fixed-point C89 core at 44.1 kHz,
stereo, signed 16-bit PCM.

wsrb89_ab_5noise_vs_7noise_rumble_crackle.wav:
  0.0-4.0 s   v1.3-style five-noise Heavy Impact
  4.0-4.5 s   silence
  4.5-8.5 s   v1.4 seven-noise Heavy Impact with rumble, crackle and motion LFO

wsrb89_rumble_crackle_layers.wav:
  0.000-3.000 s  old five-noise stack
  3.333-6.333 s  rumble layer isolated
  6.667-9.667 s  crackle layer isolated
  10.000-13.000 s full v1.4 Heavy Impact

The files contain sharp transients and strong sub-bass. Start at low volume.
